entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker, Pia and Kiran's daughter, who is pushed into giving an unsuccessful speech to rouse the inventors.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother and a renegade leader who leads the strike on the Aether Hub.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's late father and Pia's late partner, an inventor who designed the skyship; his essence lingers in its filigree.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: An aetherborn crime lord and collector who offers the renegades stored devices and admits having pushed them to act.

entities.name: Sram
entities.description: A dwarf, chief architect and senior edificer of the Aether Hub, who chews on pliers while he thinks and yields it to the renegades.

entities.name: Kambal
entities.description: The Consul of Allocation who pressures Sram to obey Tezzeret's order and then flees the Hub.

entities.name: Rajni
entities.description: Sram's assistant at the Aether Hub.

entities.name: Kailash
entities.description: A dwarf who commands the Hub's security forces and dies fighting the renegades.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The Grand Consul who tyrannically rules Ghirapur and signed an order draining the city's aether.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: The elvish aether-engineer who completes the skyship, feels Kiran's spirit and names it the Heart of Kiran.

entities.name: Mitul
entities.description: Rashmi's vedalken friend and research partner, now with the renegades.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker metalsmith who introduced Rashmi to the renegades.

entities.name: Avaati Vya
entities.description: An inventor whose prototype aether refiner is at the Museum of Invention.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: Rebel inventors who strike the Aether Hub and plan to bring down Tezzeret.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: Ghirapur's government under Tezzeret, which seized inventions and prioritizes its own aether supply.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The constantly reinventing city of Kaladesh now held by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Aether Hub
entities.description: Ghirapur's beating heart, directing the city's aether supply, which the renegades capture.

entities.name: The Spire
entities.description: Seat of Tezzeret that sent the order for constant aether flow and the renegades' next target.

entities.name: Aetherborn club
entities.description: A forgotten Ghirapur club owned by an aetherborn family that Gonti keeps off Consulate patrol routes.

entities.name: Gonti's office
entities.description: An opulent office at the end of a secret tunnel and Gonti's storeroom.

entities.name: The renegade warehouse
entities.description: A cavernous warehouse where the skyship is built and dedicated.

entities.name: Museum of Invention
entities.description: Museum holding Avaati Vya's prototype aether refiner.

entities.name: Heart of Kiran
entities.description: A massive skyship designed long ago by Kiran Nalaar, finished by Rashmi, renamed in dedication as the Heart of Kiran.

entities.name: The Planar Bridge
entities.description: Planeswalkers' term for Rashmi's matter transporter, now in Tezzeret's hands.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: The fair after which the Consulate's crackdown began.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: Kaladesh's blue energy, whose allocation has become political.

events.summary: Pia brings Chandra to an aetherborn club protected by Gonti where sympathetic inventors gather, asking Chandra to give the speech to spark rebellion.
events.quote: Chandra, I want you to do it.

events.summary: Chandra speaks about losing her father Kiran, but the speech falls apart and she leaves the stage.
events.quote: "Hi. I'm, well, I guess you know who I am. Chandra Nalaar. Pia's daughter."

events.summary: The crowd erupts into angry complaints about what the Consulate took from them, nearly becoming a riot.
events.quote: The spark had caught quickly, and within minutes; the club threatened to become a riot

events.summary: An aetherborn emissary calms the crowd and leads Pia, Chandra and others down a secret tunnel to meet Gonti.
events.quote: revealing a tunnel and a descending set of stairs.

events.summary: Chandra accuses Gonti of betraying them, but Gonti says he pushed them to act and offers the contents of his storeroom for the insurrection.
events.quote: I believe I have what you'll need for your little insurrection.

events.summary: Junctions at the Aether Hub malfunction as Sram is called to investigate by a Consulate escort.
events.quote: That was the fourth junction that had "malfunctioned" this evening

events.summary: Consul Kambal demands Sram carry out Tezzeret's order to divert the city's aether to the Spire; Sram demands it in writing.
events.quote: "You have your orders, Senior Edificer," said Kambal.

events.summary: Explosions at the Hub interrupt the dispute and Kambal flees by airship.
events.quote: "Explosion at junction nine!" said an edificer.

events.summary: Sram orders a full lockdown and then shuts down the pumps, guessing the renegades jammed the shutoffs open.
The renegades storm the Hub by gondola and breach the security doors, killing Kailash and defeating her troops.
events.quote: Kailash and her troops went down fighting.

events.summary: Pia confronts Sram, who yields the Aether Hub to the renegades.
events.quote: "Then I yield," said Sram. "The Aether Hub is yours."

events.summary: Rashmi and Mitul finish the skyship while renegades are away, Rashmi planning to leave and stop inventing afterward.
events.quote: This was the last thing she would make that would be used for harm.

events.summary: The renegades return victorious; Pia announces the Hub is won and calls on them to bring down Tezzeret.
events.quote: "We've won the day!" Pia cried to more cheers.

events.summary: Rashmi finds the initials K.N. on the skyship and feels Kiran's spirit and love of invention through the filigree.
events.quote: Two letters, carefully carved by an artistic hand: K.N.

events.summary: Rashmi realizes the revolution is about the spirit of invention and decides to stay.
events.quote: There was more to this skyship, more to this revolution, than she had allowed herself to see.

events.summary: Rashmi dedicates the skyship as the Heart of Kiran, and Mitul and Rashmi remain to pursue temporal aether research.
events.quote: So I dedicate this skyship the Heart of Kiran,

relations.quote: Pia's late partner, and the inventor who had designed this ship so long ago.
the inventor who had designed this ship so long ago.
Kambal, the Consul of Allocation, was the only one of those superiors who still gave Sram orders.

relations.note: Sram is the Hub's chief architect and senior edificer.
Kailash commands security forces guarding the building.
relations.quote: Kailash, a fellow dwarf who commanded the security forces that guarded the building.
She looked up into her friend's earnest eyes.

relations.note: She leads the strike on the Hub although she claims nobody is in charge.
relations.quote: "Pia Nalaar," he said. "So you're in charge of all this?"

relations.note: Gonti keeps the club off patrol routes and offers supplies.
relations.quote: Gonti keeps this place off the Consulate patrol routes.

relations.note: Renegades plan to bring him down.
relations.quote: It's up to us to take him down!

relations.note: The Hub is Ghirapur's beating heart.
relations.quote: An elf had once described the Aether Hub to him as Ghirapur's beating heart.
